about: ws-sibling-compare: the APPROVED skills of each kit template (process rule 0b: a lane's red matrix row is engine debt only at or below these skills' counts on the same row and size). A skill is listed here when it passed its critic on that template; changed only with a STATUS note. `pairs` (optional) gives a lane skill the siblings of its own size band, as the pilot-su-c lead's comparison did (design/audit/runs/pilot-su-c/sibling-compare.cjs); without a pair every approved sibling of the template is used.
